text:
morgan: Quick update  pausing the current release train while we investigate intermittent kernel OOMs affecting inference instances in us-west-2. Estimated hold = 24-48h, but we may shorten if the patch lands quickly. Please do not merge new train PRs for the next hour. :warning:

deploy-bot: [automated] health-check: 9/60 canaries failed in region=us-west-2. Link: https://internal.tools/canary/status

samira: Any immediate impact to Dedicated customers or reserved pools?

ops-oncall: Reserved pools are stable. Impact is on autoscaled shared infra only. If your canary depends on burst capacity, expect delays. Escalate to #infra-allocations for SLA impacts. :eyes:

elin: Heads-up  switching to our mitigation flow: well divert non-pinned canaries to eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1 to keep verification moving.

release-coordinator: New temporary governance rule (effective now): if >10% of active canaries in a region fail for >15m, the train auto-pauses until triage completes. This is to avoid cascading rollouts. Exceptions allowed for verified P0 hotfixes only.

morgan: Exception flow: file a ticket in the release-train board with label "hotfix-exception" and tag @release-coordinator + @ops-oncall. We aim to respond within 20-30m.

deploy-bot: To list canaries that are movable:
```
rrctl canary list --region=us-west-2 --filter=movable=true
```

release-coordinator: To request a region pin for a canary, comment on the canary ticket with `pin: us-west-2`. Pinned canaries will not be reassigned.

elin: Ops will start a rolling kernel patch on a subset of nodes in the next 2h. We'll monitor for eviction reduction. If stable, we'll resume the train sooner.

morgan: I'll post a status update in 90m or when we have a patch rollout signal. Thanks for keeping PRs paused and for the quick heads-up. Please drop any urgent exception requests here. :thumbsup:
